StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

DisplayAmount.rationale: SlothPower.cs:20 shows `_cardsPlayedThisTurn` on the badge. Presentation only.

ShouldPlay.rationale: `_cardsPlayedThisTurn < base.Amount` maps exactly to powers.py:2673. C#'s `card.Owner.Creature != base.Owner -> true` is a single-player tautology (Sloth is applied to the player). Note hook_dispatch gap G1's observation that the sim's should_play_card dispatcher has no `preventer` out-param, so which listener vetoed is unobservable -- inert here.

BeforeCardPlayed.issue: WRONG SIDE OF THE PLAY. C# increments the counter in `BeforeCardPlayed` (SlothPower.cs:31-40), i.e. before the card resolves; the sim increments in `on_card_played`, after. The sim HAS the right slot -- `before_card_played` (combat.py:466), which ChainsOfBindingPower's sibling port and StranglePower both use. Consequence: a card that plays or auto-plays ANOTHER card during its own resolution sees a stale count, so with Sloth 1 the sim allows the nested play and the game refuses it. Reachable in shape from ported auto-play content -- StampedePower (powers.py:1025-1041), One-Two Punch, Duplication, Howl from Beyond -- but DORMANT on co-occurrence: Sloth comes from the Knowledge Demon's Curse of Knowledge (monsters/hive/knowledge_demon.py) and reaching it with an auto-player in hand is possible but not demonstrated here, and per binding rule 6 an undemonstrated route is labelled dormant. Named unported/undemonstrated thing that would make it live: an executed witness of a Curse-of-Knowledge Sloth alongside a turn-end auto-play. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

BeforeSideTurnStart.rationale: CORRECT slot, and worth stating because most of half B's turn hooks are not: BeforeSideTurnStart is dispatched at CombatManager.cs:458, before the draw, and the sim's on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) is fired before `_draw(...)` at :183 -- the section-5 slot table's `BeforeSideTurnStart -> on_player_turn_start` row. The `participants.Contains(base.Owner)` test becomes `player is self.owner`, which is exact for a player-owned power.

guards.rationale: Closed game-wide, re-verified 2026-07-26. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/power_census.py visible` reports 0 IsVisibleInternal overrides of 260 files. That 260 is the .cs files DIRECTLY under src/Core/Models/Powers and EXCLUDES the 16 in Powers/Mocks/ (276 including them); a recursive `grep -rn IsVisibleInternal src/Core/Models/Powers/`, which does cover Mocks/, also returns 0 -- so IsVisible is provably always true for every power in the decompiled game, mocks included. CITATION FIX (2026-07-26 review fix pass): the property lives in src/Core/Models/PowerModel.cs, NOT under Models/Powers/ -- `IsVisible` is the non-virtual property at PowerModel.cs:150-160 and the overridable virtual is `IsVisibleInternal` at PowerModel.cs:167.
